note: Albany County Fairgrounds on the south edge of Laramie (S 3rd St / US-287). The RV row is southwest of the rodeo grandstand: from the North Rodeo Gate go around the west side of the grandstand, or from the main (south) gate head between the yellow and red buildings toward the grandstand. Open ground, no shade. --Claude
